editions.title: Doom Gets A Horde Mode; Reggie Gets A Sale Notice
editions.standfirst: Terry (PC, Steam Deck, master race, full price on day one) and Reggie (PS5, saving for a Pro, waiting for the sale) read through the latest gaming news and argue about every bit of it. Everything in big type is made up, and so is the arguing. Everything in the boxes is real.

stories.headline: Free Horde Mode Arrives With Nineteen Arenas; Sofa Counted As A Twentieth
stories.satire: Reggie wants to know whether a mode counts as free if you have to own an expansion first. Terry says it absolutely does, because he has owned the expansion since the day it came out, at full price, and would like that noted in the minutes. Reggie says he will join the horde as soon as the expansion drops in a sale, and has promised to count the arenas twice to be sure. Terry wins this one, by the narrowest of margins and the widest of smiles.
stories.real: id Software's free horde mode for DOOM: The Dark Ages is due on 16 November for players who own the Revelations expansion, and its trailer shows 19 arenas.

stories.headline: Masked Mystery Character To Be Unmasked On 5 December; Nation Given Three Weeks To Guess Wrong
stories.satire: Terry has guessed already, at full price, with total confidence, and is certain the answer is somebody who owns a Steam Deck. Reggie has placed a bet too: nothing, on nobody, which he calls the only safe wager in gaming. They argued about whether guessing wrongly early is better than not guessing at all. Reggie wins, since he cannot possibly be wrong about a bet he has not made, and has asked for that to be written down.
stories.real: Epic says the identity of Fortnite's masked Captain X will be revealed at a live event on 5 December, which also closes the Treasure Hunters season. Epic has not confirmed any of the fan theories.

stories.headline: Deckbuilder Adds A New Character And Two Modes; The Cards Were Not Consulted
stories.satire: Terry says a card game is the natural habitat of the master race, because shuffling is basically overclocking. Reggie says he has played cards for years using a pack from a pub, which was free and has all fifty-two cards, give or take the three of clubs. They argued over whether a new character is a new friend or a new rival. Neither of them has a deck. Terry has a spreadsheet of one. Nobody wins, and the three of clubs is still missing.
stories.real: Slay the Spire 2's biggest update so far, version 0.113.0, reached the beta branch and adds a new playable character, two new game modes and many bug fixes, according to Instant Gaming.

stories.headline: Open-World Racer Heads For PS5 In January; Reggie Starts Practising Parking
stories.satire: Reggie is thrilled, and has reserved a space on the sofa for the occasion. Terry has been driving it since day one, at full price, and says he has seen everything in it twice. Reggie says that is perfect, because by the time the game reaches him in a sale it will be fully patched, fully explored and fully spoiled, which he calls a premium experience. Reggie wins. Terry has gone to look for a shortcut.
stories.real: A roadmap for Forza Horizon 6 says the game comes to PS5 in January 2027, with Series 8 and Series 9 content arriving before the end of 2026.

stories.headline: Adventurer Gets A Second Batch Of Boxes; Shelf Declared Limited, Like The Edition
stories.satire: Terry does not buy boxes. The master race keeps its shelves empty and its library enormous, and he finds a shelf full of cases rather quaint. Reggie loves a box, and likes the word limited even more, until he remembers that limited means paying promptly. They argued over who owns the console it fits. Neither of them does. Terry wins on shelf space, Reggie wins on dust, and the adventurer is still hanging off a ledge somewhere, waiting for a verdict.
stories.real: Limited Run Games announced a new batch of physical Switch 2 copies of Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition to mark the series' 30th anniversary, after the first batch sold out quickly.

stories.headline: Launch Day To Get A Twenty-Four-Hour Stream; Kettle Asked To Brace Itself
stories.satire: Terry will watch every minute on a second monitor and calls it multitasking. Reggie will watch the first ten minutes, a bit of the middle and the end, then catch up on the highlights, all for free, and wants it known that this is a very respectable way to buy a game. Terry says it is not buying anything. Reggie says exactly. Reggie wins on price, Terry wins on stamina, and the kettle has handed in its notice.
stories.real: YouTube's official channel will carry a 24-hour GTA VI stream starting at midnight on 19 November, with a pre-show from 11pm, according to Instant Gaming.

link.text: Fancy a big game that downloads in seconds? Try the arcade.

stories.headline: London Hands Out Twenty-Five Golden Joysticks; Nation's Mantelpiece Measured
stories.satire: Terry voted in every category and says the trophies ought to be handed straight to the PC. Reggie voted once, on the grounds that he is a man of principle and the voting was free, and has awarded himself a gold joystick for services to bargain hunting. He has raised an invoice for the engraving. Terry points out that a trophy in a Steam library cannot be dusted. Reggie says that is a selling point. Reggie wins, with a trophy that does not exist.
stories.real: The 44th Golden Joystick Awards took place in London with 25 awards in total, most chosen by fan vote and three by a panel of judges, according to Instant Gaming.

stories.headline: Game-Tracking Site Gets A Phone App; Backlog Now Available In Pocket Size
stories.satire: Terry's backlog lives on Steam, grows on release day and is, he says, an investment. Reggie's backlog is made entirely of sale bargains he has not yet opened, and he is quietly proud that every single one cost less than a sandwich. They argued about whose pile is bigger. A phone app can now settle it, which neither of them wants. Reggie wins, because his pile was cheaper, and Terry's has a lot more digits.
stories.real: Backloggd's mobile app entered closed beta on 13 November for Patreon members, Android first, with a public beta planned for spring 2027, according to Instant Gaming.

stories.headline: PS5 Gets A Smarter Picture Booster; Pro Wish-List Suddenly Feels Awkward
stories.satire: Reggie is delighted, since a free boost for his ordinary PS5 means one fewer reason to buy the Pro, and every reason he does not have is worth a pound. He has moved the Pro to the pending tray. Terry says the master race had sharp pixels years ago, from a box with a fan like a jet engine. Reggie says the sofa is quieter. Reggie wins, with wounded dignity intact, and Terry has gone quiet about frame rates.
stories.real: Sony's QSSR graphics enhancer is live in Marvel's Spider-Man 2 on the base PS5, and Push Square reports it is due to reach more games in the coming weeks.

stories.headline: Subscription Sale Starts Today For Two Weeks; Reggie Studies The Small Print Like A Treaty
stories.satire: Reggie signed up ages ago, which means the discount is not for him, and he has taken it very personally. He is considering leaving and rejoining as a brand new customer in a different hat. Terry says Steam has no subscription, so no catch, no small print and no hat. Reggie says Steam has sales too, and Terry has never once waited for one. A draw: the hat stays in the cupboard, and Reggie's dignity has been put on hold.
stories.real: Sony's PS Plus memberships go on sale from 16 November for two weeks, but the discounted prices apply only to new sign-ups, according to Push Square.

link.text: Want to see what a price looks like when it is free? Try the arcade.

stories.headline: Taxi Game Announces Fifth And Final Stop; Meter Left Running
stories.satire: Terry wants the final stop to be wherever his rig is, and expects a tip. Reggie has already sent the fare for all five stops in a single invoice, plus a small charge for the journey that has not happened yet, and calls it a nice little earner. Terry says nobody is paying, since the game is not due until next year. Reggie says that is why he is billing early. Reggie wins, on a technicality he has not explained.
stories.real: SEGA confirmed India as the fifth and final destination of Crazy Taxi: World Tour, joining the West Coast, Germany, Japan and Brazil, and Push Square says the game is due in 2027.

editions.terry: And that, ladies and gentlemen, is Monday! Every word made up apart from the boxes, which are real, and arrived on release day at full price. Back tomorrow, and bring a spare monitor!
editions.reggie: Check the boxes, my old son, that's where the truth lives. Everything else is a bargain, and a bargain is only a bargain if you wait for it. Back tomorrow, and mind the kettle.

editions.title: Zelda Sells Five Million; Cats Get A Simulator
editions.standfirst: Terry (PC, Steam Deck, master race, full price on day one) and Reggie (PS5, saving for a Pro, waiting for the sale) go through the last few days in gaming and argue about all of it. Everything in big type is made up, and so is the arguing. Everything in the boxes is real.
editions.terry: That's the gaming news, ladies and gentlemen! Every word made up apart from the boxes, which are real, and run beautifully at a locked 144 frames. Press start tomorrow morning, seven ish!
editions.reggie: Check the box underneath, my old son, that's where the truth lives. And if the arguing gets you down, wait a month and it'll be half price. My fee for refereeing is a tenner, payable in cash, no console required.

stories.headline: Hero Sells 5.2 Million Copies Before Anyone Has Found The Last Heart Piece
stories.satire: Terry says a handheld that plays everything is the only civilised way to celebrate, and wants it known that he bought it on day one, at full price, like a gentleman. Reggie is waiting for the sale and says five million people can't be wrong, only early. They argued about whether a master race is allowed to wait for a console to come down in price. Reggie raised an invoice for services as a silent hero. It is for a tenner, and it is silent too.
stories.real: Nintendo said the Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake sold more than 5.2 million copies worldwide in its first four days on Switch 2 after its 5 November launch, which it says is the fastest start for any game it has published on the console.

stories.headline: Fourteen Games Launch In One Day; Nation Can Now Be A Cat, A Banker Or A Cleaner
stories.satire: Terry bought all fourteen on release day, on Steam, at full price, and is now a cat with a very high spec. Reggie is holding out for seventy per cent off and has put the banker on his PS5 wishlist until further notice. They argued over who gets the house cleaner, and Terry said it runs at a smoother frame rate on a proper rig. Reggie said a smoother frame rate does not make the washing up any drier.
stories.real: PureXbox counted 14 games launching on Xbox on 13 November, including Cat Simulator, Banker Simulator and House Cleaner Simulator.

link.text: Want a cat game with tricycles and a promenade full of Dreamies? Play Grand Theft Kitty.

stories.headline: Third Instalment Confirmed 'In Production'; Production Confirmed To Be Where Games Come From
stories.satire: Terry has pre-ordered a game that does not exist yet, at full price, on the strength of the number three alone. Reggie says he will pick it up in about 2029, in a sale, for the price of a sausage roll, and will be perfectly happy. They argued over which of them gets the better deal: the early adopter who pays the most, or the man who gets the game after everyone else has found all the secrets. Nobody has checked the date. The studio has not been consulted.
stories.real: Game Informer reported on 13 November that Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production.

stories.headline: God Of War Spin-Off Heads For The PS4; The Console Is Thrilled To Be Asked
stories.satire: Reggie is delighted. His PS5 is waiting for a Pro it cannot afford, so a spin-off arriving on the old PS4 in the loft feels like a very small win, and he has gone up with a torch. Terry says the master race do not look backwards and has asked, once more, what a PS4 is. They argued about whether a console in a loft counts as retired or resting. Reggie says resting, and that he will wait for the price of the PS4 to go down a bit more.
stories.real: Instant Gaming reported on 13 November that the Metroidvania spin-off God of War: Sons of Sparta will get a free content update and launch on PS4 on 16 November.

stories.headline: Halo Remake Gets Firefight Mode; Terry Insists On Being The Fire
stories.satire: Terry says he will be the Fire, and has bought a headset for the occasion, at full price, to hear it properly. Reggie says that makes him the Fight, and he will join in as soon as the new mode comes down in a sale. They argued for forty minutes about whether a game that plays better on a rig beats a game that plays slightly worse on a sofa with a biscuit. Somebody pointed out that the mode is for several players, and the two of them are on the same sofa.
stories.real: Instant Gaming reported on 13 November that Halo: Campaign Evolved, the remake of the first Halo's story, is getting a new mode called Firefight.

stories.headline: Golden Trophies Await; Nominees Told To Look Casual Until Tuesday
stories.satire: Terry has written four acceptance speeches, bought a bow tie at full price and says the master race expects to take the lot. Reggie has put himself forward for Best Supporting Invoice and expects to be unopposed, with a bargain bundle thrown in. They argued about who thanks whom first, and agreed to thank the cats, who were not consulted. Nominees have until Tuesday to practise a face for losing graciously. Terry is practising on a very good webcam.
stories.real: Final Weapon reported on 14 November that the Game Awards 2026 nominees will be announced in a live stream on 17 November, with the ceremony itself on 10 December.

stories.headline: Boxed Edition Contains A Code, Not A Disc; Nation Opens Box, Finds Slightly Fancier Receipt
stories.satire: Terry opened the box and found a card with a code on it, and has now installed the pre-load, which has eaten most of his storage. He says the master race can take a few hundred gigabytes on the chin. Reggie is delighted: a smart box with nothing in it is the oldest trick going, and he will wait for the discount, thank you very much. They argued over whether a box counts as part of the game. Reggie has put a bid in for all the empty ones.
stories.real: A roundup of Rockstar's Newswire post of 10 November says boxed copies of GTA VI, due in shops from 12 November, contain a download code rather than a disc, and that the pre-load needs up to 212 GB of space.

link.text: Our games need no box, no code and no 212GB. Visit the arcade.

stories.headline: Ten Games In Twelve Years, Then Thirteen Years For The Next; Maths Teacher Applauds
stories.satire: Terry bought every one of the ten on release day, at full price, and says the master race has been paying for the privilege since Vice City. Reggie has been waiting for a sale for thirteen years and believes it is nearly due. They argued over whether paying the most is a hobby or a medical condition. Reggie thinks it is the only business where the longer the customer waits, the more they thank you, and he intends to try it with his rent. The calendar has not commented.
stories.real: GamesRadar noted on 14 November that Rockstar released the first ten Grand Theft Auto games in just twelve years, as the 13-year wait for GTA 6 comes to an end.

stories.headline: Parcel-Delivery Game Joins Subscription Library; Nation Told To Take Its Time
stories.satire: Reggie is thrilled, because a game that arrives free with a subscription is the best sale there is, and has booked himself a whole weekend of it. Terry says the master race would rather pay full price than borrow a thing from a library, and has bought a second copy to be safe. They argued about who carries the heavy parcel. Terry has a very good chair. Reggie has a very good excuse. The cat has gone on ahead with the small one.
stories.real: Fandomwire reported on 14 November that PlayStation's November Game Catalog additions include the PS5 game Death Stranding 2: On the Beach, arriving on 17 November.

stories.headline: Minigame Loses Certain Words; Minigame Asks Which Ones
stories.satire: Terry typed a word to see if it had gone, on a keyboard that lights up in nine colours, and was refused in all nine. Reggie typed it on a controller, one letter at a time, and was refused at a much more dignified pace. They argued about which of them had written the worst word and agreed it was the one Terry will not repeat. Reggie wants it noted that a bargain keyboard from a car boot would have been refused too, and for a good deal less.
stories.real: GamesRadar reported on 14 November that Final Fantasy 14 patched certain words out of Keyboard Brawler, a limited-time minigame in the game.
